Class ViewUtils

java.lang.Object

    • setCursor

      public static void setCursor(JComponent component)
      Sets an appropriate mouse cursor for the given Swing component based on its type.

      This method applies a context-aware cursor to improve user experience:

      • Text input components (e.g., JTextField, JSpinner) receive a text cursor.
      • Interactive components (e.g., JButton, JCheckBox, JRadioButton) receive a hand cursor.
      • All other components receive the default cursor.
      Parameters:
      component - the Swing component to which the cursor will be applied

    • setupAutoComplete

      public static <T> void setupAutoComplete(JComboBox<ComboBoxItem<T>> comboBox, ArrayList<ComboBoxItem<T>> allItems)
      Enables dynamic autocomplete behavior on an editable JComboBox.

      The combo box content is filtered in real time according to the text entered by the user. Matching is case-insensitive and based on the textual representation of each ComboBoxItem.

      Supported keyboard behavior:

      • Typing: filters the available items and automatically displays the popup when matches exist.
      • ENTER: validates the current value.
        • If an exact match exists, the corresponding item is selected.
        • Otherwise, the typed text is preserved without selection.
      • ESCAPE: restores the original list, clears the editor, removes the current selection, and closes the popup.
      • Navigation keys (arrows, shift, control) are ignored to avoid interfering with standard combo box navigation behavior.

      The original item list provided in allItems is never modified. Filtering only affects the temporary combo box model displayed to the user.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type wrapped by each ComboBoxItem
      Parameters:
      comboBox - the editable combo box to enhance with autocomplete
      allItems - the complete immutable reference list used for filtering

    • rebuildModel

      private static <T> void rebuildModel(JComboBox<ComboBoxItem<T>> comboBox, ArrayList<ComboBoxItem<T>> allItems)
      Rebuilds the combo box model using the complete reference item list.

      This method restores the original state of the combo box after filtering operations by replacing the current model with a new model containing all available items.

      Type Parameters:
      T - the type wrapped by each ComboBoxItem
      Parameters:
      comboBox - the target combo box whose model must be rebuilt
      allItems - the full list of items to reinsert into the model

    • resizeColumnWidth

      public static void resizeColumnWidth(JTable table)
      Adjusts the preferred width of each column in the specified JTable based on the content of its cells and headers.

      The method iterates through all rows and columns to determine the maximum preferred width required for displaying the cell contents without truncation. It also takes the column header width into account and applies additional padding for better readability.

      Parameters:
      table - the JTable whose column widths should be resized
